title: Diary of a Journey through Syria and Palestine by Nâsir-i-Khusrau, in 1047 A.D.
version: Guy Le Strange (trans.), Palestine Pilgrims’ Text Society, title-page imprint 1888, bound in the 1897 vol. IV. Cornell University Library scan, Internet Archive item cu31924028534281.
lineage: English rendering of the same travel account. Le Strange’s preface p. viii names British Museum Add. 18,418 and Or. 1991 as his manuscripts and acknowledges emendations from Schefer’s text.

passages.locator: Preface pp. iv, viii; pp. 23 and 26
passages.note: The preface places contemporary Jerusalem under Fatimid rule and describes the translator’s sources. Page 23 assigns the arrival of 5 Ramadan 438 AH to 1047. Page 26 describes the endowed hospital, remedies and physician stipends and locates a wall of the Friday mosque beside the valley.
